name: BACoMaB Petites Subventions window

funder.name: BACoMaB Trust Fund (Fonds Fiduciaire du Banc d'Arguin et de la Biodiversité Côtière et Marine)

summary: Annual small-grants window of a Mauritanian conservation trust fund for legally recognised civil society organisations running monitoring, shared governance, livelihoods and awareness activities in marine and coastal protected areas.

calls.label: Annual call (June)
calls.recurring: The fund issues its invitation to submit every June, stating the envelope and the submission deadline.

status.quote: Chaque année, en juin, le BACoMaB invite les gestionnaires des zones bénéficiaires éligibles (Guichet AMP) et les organisations de la société civile des Parcs (Guichet Petites Subventions) à lui soumettre un projet ou des activités.
